overview: This Senate resolution congratulates the Oklahoma State University men's cross country team on winning the 2025 NCAA Division I national championship, the team's sixth national title and its second in three years. It notes the team also won the Big 12 and NCAA Midwest Regional championships, recognizes several runners who earned All-America honors, and notes that head coach Dave Smith was named national coach of the year. The Senate approved it by unanimous consent on January 6, 2026.
for: Supporters say it is a fitting way to recognize the dedication and achievement of student-athletes and their school.
against: Critics say it is symbolic and doesn't change any law or spending.
